# MRXplorer

> MRXplorer teaches live virtual AI classes for market researchers and insights
> teams. Taught by Z Johnson, a 20+ year market research veteran. Two cohort
> tracks: Beginner ($395 cohort) and Intermediate ($995 cohort). Classes are 90
> minutes, live, virtual, Pacific time.

## Classes
- [Class catalog](https://www.mrxplorer.com/classes): beginner and intermediate cohort classes with descriptions, pricing, and schedule

## About
- [About Z Johnson](https://www.mrxplorer.com/about): instructor background — Microsoft research director, Ipsos, Course5, insights-tech leadership
- [Contact](https://www.mrxplorer.com/contact): booking and inquiries
